column1: # *** FOUR HITS, FOUR ARTEFACTS, AND NOT ONE REAL LERENA LERENA IN THE URUGUAYAN CATHOLIC REGISTERS. ***
# This is a CONTROLLED null and not a silent one: the query returned four documents, so the search ran.
# Each was opened and each transcript read. The doubling is a known behaviour of the machine
# transcription at line and page ends - and it produced the same false positive FOUR TIMES, which is
# worth knowing on its own account before anyone trusts a compound-surname hit again.
# *** WHAT IT DOES AND DOES NOT SETTLE. ***
#   - It says: in the Uruguayan Catholic registers, no child of two Lerenas is recorded under the
#     compound. That is consistent with the dispensation sweep's finding that every Lerena in it
#     marries out, and it is INDEPENDENT of that sweep.
#   - *** IT DOES NOT SETTLE THE QUESTION. *** Pablo Armando was born at ROSARIO DE SANTA FE and his
#     parents were presumably married in ARGENTINA. A Uruguayan corpus cannot speak to an Argentine
#     marriage, and Argentine registers use the compound far less consistently. *** The same query must
#     be run against the Argentine collections before this means anything about Maria. ***
#   - And a woman can be a Lerena by birth without her children ever being written LERENA LERENA - the
#     card itself writes her simply "Maria Lerena".
# ================ *** AND THEN RUN AGAIN WITHOUT THE URUGUAY FILTER, THE SAME HOUR *** ================
# The caution above said the test meant nothing until it was run against Argentina. It was.
# *** 43 DOCUMENTS WORLDWIDE. NOT ONE IS A LERENA MARRIED TO A LERENA. ***
#   - The ARGENTINE hit - Libro de Bautismos N.35, Chacabuco, Buenos Aires, 1909-1910 - is "G. Lerena
#     Lerena" written across the printed title page of the book. An annotation, doubled. ARTEFACT.
#   - *** The MONTEVIDEO MARRIAGE DISPENSATION of July-August 1911 is a real and valuable document ***
#     and it is still not a Lerena-Lerena marriage: see data/1911-lerena-cardozo-dispensation.tsv.
#   - The only GENUINE compounds in all 43 are COLOMBIAN - an "Elena Lerena Llerena" at Calamar,
#     Bolivar, in baptisms of the 1990s. A different family on a different continent.
# *** SO THE ANSWER IS AS CLEAN AS THIS CORPUS CAN GIVE: in five million searchable pages across
# Uruguay, Argentina, Spain and everywhere else FamilySearch has transcribed, NO CHILD OF TWO LERENAS
# IS RECORDED UNDER THE COMPOUND. *** The query works - it returned 43 documents and each was opened.
# *** WHAT IT STILL DOES NOT SETTLE, and this has not changed: *** a woman can be a Lerena by birth
# without her children ever being written LERENA LERENA, and the enrolment card itself writes Pablo
# Armando simply "LERENA". Full-text covers only what has been transcribed, and Rosario de Santa Fe's
# parish books are thin in it. *** This lowers the probability that Maria Lerena was a Lerena by
# birth. It does not close it, and no Lerena-Lerena marriage should now be asserted anywhere. ***
# ================ AND THREE LERENA WOMEN FOUND IN PASSING ================
# None of them known to this archive before today. All SECONDARY - transcripts read, images not opened.
#   *** AMELIA LERENA *** - m. EDUARDO DEL SUANDO [reading uncertain]; son Luis baptised at Pocitos,
#     Montevideo, 15 August 1903, born 21 June 1903. *** Her parents: AVELINO and CELIDONIA B. de
#     LERENA. *** Which is a problem worth stating: this archive's Avelino Lerena Fernandez married
#     AMBROSIA TRAIBEL and died in 1890. Either he had a second wife, or CELIDONIA belongs to a
#     different Avelino - and there are already two others. NOT attached to anyone.
#   *** ZELMIRA LERENA *** - m. ADOLFO CORDERO, "argentino"; son Adolfo Angel Faustino born 15 Feb
#     1905, baptised San Jose de Mayo 12 April 1905. *** An ARGENTINE husband, at the right date. ***
#   *** JUSTINA LERENA *** - godmother at Trinidad, April 1891. The Trinidad kindred is already in this
#     register; she may be one of them under another spelling.
